done_when: No test and no Forge command can change the real repository's git settings through an inherited git environment: an autouse fixture clears GIT_* variables for every test, not only tests using the repo fixture; Forge's own temporary-repository git calls (migrate's source fetch) run without GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE; one command test runs those paths with GIT_DIR pointing at a separate sentinel repository and checks its core.bare stays false; new and existing client repos get the migrate change on upgrade
why: Forge's own repo was switched to a bare repository (core.bare = true) while tests ran, which stopped every git command in its main checkout and worktrees
